subject: PoC mode qualification and action checklist (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>

Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: PoC mode qualification and action checklist (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Hi Elaine — great conversation earlier today, thanks for walking through the integration surface and security constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Recap of customer constraints and preference:
- Primary data classification: controlled PHI and sensitive PII (EHR-derived).
- Regulatory constraint: must retain audit logs and key management under our control.
- Preference: leaning strongly toward Private VPC, but want to validate SLOs and infra cost vs Dedicated as a fallback.

Proposed PoC goals (provisional):
1) Functional: inference integration end-to-end with a 10k monthly user simulation and 95th percentile latency < 350ms for typical 512-token prompts.
2) Security/compliance: KMS/HSM integration and audit logs available for a 30-day window; SOC2 evidence review.
3) Operational: deployment runbook, hostfailover plan, and cost delta analysis (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Suggested timeline (two-week pacing):
- Week 0 (this week): stakeholder confirm + access requests (security questionnaire + SOC2 snapshot). Owner: HealthBridge security (Raj).
- Week 1: Tech deep-dive + sample data ingestion + quick perf smoke runs (Redwood infra + HealthBridge infra). Owner: Priyom.
- Week 2: Private VPC dry-run (networking checks) OR Dedicated provisioning test if VPC blocked. Owner: Lauren / Redwood infra.

Action items (please ack):
- Elaine / Raj: confirm the two security reviewers and provide SOC2 snapshot and preferred KMS vendor (by 2027-06-02).
- Priyom (Redwood SE): prepare a short runbook for private VPC connectivity and an initial cost estimate (by 2027-06-04).
- Lauren (CS): prep a short success-criteria doc and coordinate scheduling for the tech deep-dive (propose two slots).

I attached a lightweight PoC-checklist.xlsx and a one-pager that contrasts Hosted vs Dedicated to help guide the internal decision. If Private VPC is required we’ll scope the networking dry-run first and treat Dedicated as a contingency to meet earlier timelines.

Proposed slots for tech deep-dive: 2027-06-07 09:00-10:00 PT or 2027-06-08 16:00-17:00 PT — please indicate preferred.

Thanks — I’ll capture any confirmations in the shared drive link below once I hear back.

—
Markus Klein

Subject: Re: PoC mode qualification and action checklist (Hosted / Dedicated / Private VPC)

Thanks Markus — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- Security posture: our security/compliance team (Raj Patel, CTO; Linda Chen, InfoSec) have mandated that any environment interacting with PHI must either be Private VPC or fully on-prem. Hosted API is a non-starter unless we can get a formal exception (unlikely).
- KMS: we use AWS KMS and require key material to be customer-managed (we have a cross-account KMS policy).
- Audit retention: we need 90-day access to request/response logs for e-discovery, though a 30-day hot window with archived retrieval is acceptable if retrieval SLA is documented.

We can share SOC2 snapshot and a short compliance brief by Wed 2027-06-02. For the tech deep-dive, the earlier slot (2027-06-07 09:00 PT) works for Raj and Linda.

Next step for us: please produce a short Private VPC checklist (network ranges, peering requirements, firewall rules) and an estimate for ramp/provisioning time so we can brief procurement.

Best,
Elaine Murray
Head of Integrations | HealthBridge
elaine.murray@healthbridge.com

Hi all — quick technical notes based on your constraints.

1) Private VPC feasibility: Redwood Private supports AWS VPC peering and Transit Gateway connections. We can do customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key). Network checklist I will draft includes CIDR allowlist, TLS endpoints, and an IPsec/Direct Connect fallback if needed.

2) SOC2: attaching a short SOC2-snapshot.pdf (redacted) for initial review — this should address the top security questions for procurement. We'll follow up with the full questionnaire once we get a signed NDA if required.

3) Perf and SLO: for a PoC sized to 10k simulated monthly users, our recommendation is to run the PoC on a small Redwood Private rack or Dedicated pool to validate latency and caching behavior. Hosted would limit our ability to guarantee KMS segregation. Cost delta: I’ll produce a numerical estimate (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) but provisioning time for a Private VPC dry-run (networking + access) is typically 4–7 business days once access is granted.

Action items I’ll take on:
- Draft Private VPC checklist and share by 2027-06-02.
- Produce a short one-page cost delta with provisioning windows by 2027-06-04.

—
